rationale: wsl_vault.ps1 is opv's own child process; its stdout is a private pipe that opv reads (bounded::run_child, wsl.rs) straight into zeroized memory, and it never reaches the agent, a terminal, --json, MCP or a file. A child returning a value to opv needs some stream; this is the narrowest. e2e no-leak canaries (s12) pass.
